findings.motion: H. 5500 (FY2027 budget), on adoption of amendment #1587, An Act relative to identification to vote (Lombardo), recorded for 'Mr. Speaker'
findings.note: Roll call No. 174 lists 'Mr. Speaker' (the Speaker of the House, Ronald Mariano) as N. The amendment would require a valid government-issued photo ID to receive a ballot at the polls, and would have the Secretary of the Commonwealth provide a free photo ID card to any registered voter without one who signs an affidavit. It was rejected 27 yeas to 131 nays. Amendment text: https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/194/H5500/1587/House/Content ; report: https://recorder.com/2026/05/08/beacon-hill-roll-call-april-27-to-may-1-2026/ (a No vote is against requiring voters to present an ID).
subjects: free state photo ID for voting

findings.motion: H. 4000 (FY2026 budget), on adoption of amendment #409, An Act relative to identification to vote (Lombardo), recorded for 'Mr. Speaker'
findings.note: Roll call No. 42 lists 'Mr. Speaker' (Ronald Mariano) as N. Amendment #409 to H4000 has the same opening text as the 2026 amendment, rewriting G.L. c. 54 s. 76 on voter check-in at the polls to require photo identification. It was rejected 25 yeas to 131 nays. Amendment text: https://malegislature.gov/Bills/GetAmendmentContent/194/H4000/409/House/Content

findings.passage: “The comprehensive gun reform legislation that the House passed today will make Massachusetts residents safer and will further strengthen the Commonwealth’s status as a national leader in the effort to combat gun violence,” said House Speaker Ronald J. Mariano (D-Quincy).
findings.note: Speaker's press-release statement on the House passing the 2023 firearms bill (ghost guns, red flag orders, assault-style definition, limits on carrying in some places).

findings.passage: “This agreement is the most significant gun safety legislation that Massachusetts has seen in a decade.
findings.note: Speaker's press-release statement on the Legislature passing the final 2024 firearms bill, which he calls the most significant gun safety legislation in a decade.

findings.passage: “While the Commonwealth’s existing gun laws have proven to be effective in preventing gun violence compared to other states, relative success is never a cause for complacency.
findings.note: Same release; Speaker says existing state gun laws work well but more is needed, and the agreement builds on 2014 reforms.

findings.passage: Mariano said in his email that “the Bruen decision fundamentally changed how courts review state gun laws and immediately jeopardized aspects of the laws that have made our Commonwealth a national leader in reducing gun violence.”
findings.note: Quoted by CommonWealth Beacon from the Speaker's email to House members, pausing the gun bill to answer members' questions after the Bruen ruling.

findings.passage: Gun violence in the United States is an unrelenting crisis.
findings.note: Opening of a WBUR Cognoscenti op-ed co-written by Mariano and Rep. Michael Day urging new gun control legislation (assault weapon definition update, ghost gun serialization, wider red flag petitioners, bans on carrying in schools, polling places, government buildings).
